    Build parametric psychological vectors for multi-condition gPPI

    mppi_parametric.Rd

    Build parametric psychological vectors for multi-condition gPPI

    mppi_parametric(
  fd,
  T,
  mods,
  select = NULL,
  center = TRUE,
  span_space = TRUE,
  use_nuisance = TRUE,
  include_intercept = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    fd

    fmridesign object supplying design information

    T

    integer number of TRs (rows)

    mods

    named list of numeric vectors (length T) containing trial-wise modulators

    select

    optional regular expression to restrict conditions (columns of psych(fd, ...))

    center

    logical; demean each modulator within run

    span_space

    logical; residualize against other conditions (gPPI default)

    use_nuisance

    logical; include nuisance regressors when residualising

    include_intercept

    logical; include an intercept during residualisation

    Value

    named list of vectors ready to append to pk() output
